# Bihar Aur Purnea Maize Market Report — 3 May 2026 (Ravivaar)

## Aaj Ka Haal: Ravivaar — Mandi Band, Par Bazaar Mein Bahut Kuch Ho Raha Hai!

**Kisan bhai, aaj Ravivaar (Sunday) hai — Bihar ki saari mandis BAND hain.** Aaj koi kharida-bechi nahi hogi. Daam wahi rahega jo kal Saturday ko tha — ₹1,900 per quintal (100 kilo) Purnea mandi mein.

Par aaj ki khabar mein teen badi cheezein hain jो kalke Monday ko bohot asar dalenge:

**Pehli Khabar — Gulabbagh Mandi Mein Asli Daam Zyada Tha!**
Kal Friday aur Saturday ke data se pata chalta hai ki Gulabbagh APMC mandi (Purnea ka asli sarkari bazaar jahan kisan seedha bechte hain) mein May 1 (Shukravar) ko asli trading range ₹1,960 se ₹2,110 per quintal thi! Matlab mandi ka asli daam IndiaMART ke ₹1,900 dealer price se kaafi upar tha. Yeh ek bullish (daam badhane wali) khabar hai.

**Doosri Khabar — NCDEX ₹2,000 ke paas, Buy Signal!**
NCDEX (Delhi mein ek bada sarkari fasal-bazaar — jaise gaon ka mukhia poore desh ke liye aage ka daam tay karta hai) mein makka ka May 2026 contract pichle Friday ko ₹2,000 par tha — yeh poore 52 hafte ka sabse uchha daam (52-week high) tha! Aaj Saturday close ₹1,992 par aaya — sirf ₹8 neeche. Purnea ke ₹1,900 se ₹92 UPAR — matlab bade traders bol rahe hain ki daam aur badhenge. CBOT (America ka bada makka bazaar) mein bhi puri week mein makka +13.25 cents badha. Dono bade bazaar BULLISH hain.

**Teesri Khabar — Iran ki Ladai Abhi Bhi Jari, Petrol Mehnga!**
Brent crude oil (zameen se nikalne wala kach-tel) $108.17 per barrel chal raha hai — pichle saal se 76% zyada! Iran ki ladai mein Strait of Hormuz (samandar ka rasta jahan se duniya ka 20% tel guzarta hai) abhi bhi band hai. Jab tel itna mehnga hai, toh sarkar ko petrol mein makka se banane wali sharab (ethanol) milana bahut zaroori lagta hai — toh makka ki demand BAHUT ZYADA hai.

**Par Ek Buri Khabar — Bihar Mein Bahut Zyada Fasal!**
Bihar mein rabi (sardi ki) makka ki fasal ka ruqba (area) pichle saal se **41.27% ZYADA** hai! Yeh bahut bada badlav hai — matlab is saal Bihar mein dheron zyada makka aayegi mandi mein. Zyada maal matlab daam par dabaav. Abhi bhi peak arrivals (sabse zyada maal aane ka waqt) ka daur chal raha hai — May 15 tak. Toh mandi mein maal bahut aayega, aur daam dheere dheere girnge.

**Bihar Sarkar Ka Krishi Sahayata!**
Bihar sarkar ne ek bada kadam uthaya hai — iss saal hailstorm (olo girna) aur baemausam baarish se prabhaavit makka kisanon ko Krishi Input Anudaan (matlab khet ka kharcha wapas milna — seedha bank account mein paise) de rahi hai. Deadline: 5 May 2026. Agar aapke khet ko olo ya baarish se nuksan hua hai — jaldi apply karo.

**IMD Mausam Alert:**
IMD (India Meteorological Department — India ka mausam vibhag) ne aaj 3 May ke liye Bihar ke paas ke ilakon (Sub-Himalayan West Bengal, Sikkim, Northeast India) mein bhaari baarish aur ole girne ki warning di hai. Purnea ke aas paas ke ilakon mein bhi yellow se orange alert ki sambhavna hai. Baarish matlab mandi mein maal aana thoda ruka — yeh short-term mein daam ke liye thoda achha hai. Par Monday se phir normal.

**Agle 10 Din Ka Anumaan:**
Aaj ₹1,900 se chalu hokar May 12 tak ₹1,842 tak girne ka anumaan hai — ₹58 ki girawat. Girawat dheemi hai kyunki Iran war aur NCDEX ki tezi daam ko bahut tez neeche nahi jaane de rahi. Sabse zyada girawat May 5-8 ke beech hogi jab peak arrivals apne sabse tez mode mein hongi.

**Kisan Bhai Ke Liye Ek Clear Advice:**
Somwaar ko subah mandi khulte hi — sahi quality ka maal le jaao. ₹1,960-₹2,000 milne ki sambhavna hai asli mandi mein. Par May 15 se pehle zaroor bech dena — baad mein daam aur girenge jab naya maal aur zyada aayega. Jo khareedna chahte hain — May 12-15 ka intezaar karo jab daam ₹1,840-₹1,850 par aa jaayega.

news_items.title: Bihar mein nayi rabi makka ka ruqba 41.27% ZYADA — peak arrivals abhi bhi chal rahe hain — mandi mein dheron maal — daam par bada dabaav
news_items.category: Bihar Rabi Aawaak — Nayi Fasal Ka Bada Dher
news_items.explanation:
**KYA HUA:** UPAG (Uttar Pradesh aur Bihar ki fasal ki jaankari dene wali ek sanstha) ke data se pata chala hai ki Bihar mein rabi (sardi ki season mein boi aur March-April mein kati jaane wali) makka ka ruqba (area — matlab kul kitne khet mein boi gayi) is saal pichle saal se 41.27% ZYADA hai! 7.77 lakh hectare mein makka boi gayi hai Bihar mein — yeh bahut bada ilaaka hai. Agar average paidawar rahee toh Bihar se akele 4.42 MMT (44 lakh tonne) makka aayegi.

**MATLAB KYA HAI:** Rabi arrivals matlab nayi kati hui makka ka mandi mein aana. 'Peak arrivals' ka time April 5 se May 15 hai — abhi hum May 3 par hain — matlab sabse zyada maal aane ka waqt ABHI chal raha hai. 41.27% zyada ruqba matlab 41.27% zyada maal. Bilkul waise jaise ek hi mela mein sab ek cheez bechne lage — ek saath 41% zyada dukandaar aayenge — toh sab sasta karne lagte hain. Yeh abhi tak ka sabse bada bearish (daam girne wala) factor hai.

**AAPKI FASAL PAR ASAR:** Zyada maal aata rahega agle 2 hafte tak — May 15 tak. Purnea, Khagaria, Samastipur, Begusarai, Darbhanga APMCs (sarkari mandis) mein rozana naya maal aa raha hai. Daam dheere dheere girte rahenge — approx ₹8-₹10 per quintal rozana.

**AAPKO KYA KARNA CHAHIYE:**
- Agar BECHNE wale hain: Jitna jaldi becho utna achha. Monday-Tuesday (May 4-5) sabse accha window hai. May 15 ke baad bhi mat baitho — tapering phase mein bhi daam girnge.
- Agar KHAREEDNE wale hain: May 12-15 tak ruko — ₹1,840-₹1,850 mein milega jab arrivals sabse peak par hongi.

news_items.title: Iran ki ladai jari — Strait of Hormuz abhi bhi band — Brent crude $108 — ethanol (petrol mein milane wali makka sharab) ki demand bahut zyada — makka ke liye bullish khabar
news_items.category: Geopolitics — Iran Ladai Aur Crude Oil
news_items.explanation:
**KYA HUA:** Aaj ki report mein sabse badi khabar yeh hai ki Iran aur America ke beech ki ladai abhi bhi jaari hai. Brent crude oil (zameen se nikalne wala kach-tel jisse petrol-diesel banta hai) $108.17 per barrel (ek bada dabba) chal raha hai — pichle saal ke mukable 76% ZYADA! Strait of Hormuz (ek zaroori samandar ka rasta jahan se duniya ka 20% tel guzarta hai) band hai. Trump par 60-din ka War Powers deadline ka dabaav hai — lekin ladai ruki nahi. Iran aur America dono blockade kar rahe hain.

**MATLAB KYA HAI:** Jab crude oil $108 par ho, toh makka se banane wali sharab (ethanol — jo petrol mein milai jaati hai) ki sarkar ko BAHUT ZYADA zaroorat lagti hai — kyunki petrol mehnga hai. India mein E20 ka niyam (petrol mein 20% ethanol milana lazmi) April 1 se shuru ho gaya hai. Toh distillery waale (makka se ethanol banane wali factories) lagatar khareed rahe hain. Jab zaroorat zyada aur maal thoda — toh daam upar jaata hai — bilkul waise jaise garmi mein pani ki zaroorat badh jaati hai toh pani mehnga ho jaata hai.

**AAPKI FASAL PAR ASAR:** Iran ki ladai jaari rahne tak makka ki ethanol demand unch level par rahegi. Yeh ek bada support hai jo daam ko bahut tez neeche nahi jane deta — jaise koi neeche se pakad ke rakhta hai. NCDEX ka ₹2,000 pahunchna isi wajah se hua.

**AAPKO KYA KARNA CHAHIYE:**
- Agar BECHNE wale hain: Yeh support abhi hai — aaj ya kal becho. Ladai khatam hogi toh support bhi khatam hoga.
- Agar KHAREEDNE wale hain: Jab tak ladai hai tab tak daam ₹1,900 se neeche jaana mushkil hai. ₹1,842 ka target hai May 12 tak — phir bhi accha entry point.

news_items.title: CBOT (America ka bada makka bazaar) mein makka puri week mein 13.25 cents badha — July 2026 contract 480.25 cents par — duniya mein makka mahenga ho raha hai
news_items.explanation:
**KYA HUA:** CBOT (Chicago Board of Trade — America ka sabse bada makka bazaar, jaise America ka NCDEX jahaan pure duniya ka makka ka daam tay hota hai) mein pichle ek puri trading week mein makka ka daam 13.25 cents badha. July 2026 wala contract (ZCN26) 480.25 cents per bushel (ek American measurement unit — roughly 25 kilo) par chal raha hai. Soybeans aur wheat bhi isi week mein bahut badhe — lagta hai ki duniya mein saari major crops ek saath mehngi ho rahi hain.

**MATLAB KYA HAI:** 'CBOT' ek global reference hai — jab America mein makka mehnga hota hai, toh duniya mein makka mehnga hota hai. Is tezi ki wajah hai Iran ki ladai (ethanol ki demand badhi), America mein planting season shuru (nayi crop abhi khet mein nahi aayi), aur Brazil ki fasal ki kuch uncertainty. Yeh India ke makka ke daam ke liye ek bullish (daam badhane wali) signal hai — jaise dilli mein mehangai badhe toh gaon mein bhi daam badhte hain.

**AAPKI FASAL PAR ASAR:** India mein bhi makka ke daam par is global tezi ka asar hota hai — seedha nahi, par angrejon ke liye 'import parity' (bahar se mangaana kitna padega) ka hisaab lagane par. NCDEX ka ₹2,000 pahunchna bhi CBOT ki tezi ki wajah se tha.

**AAPKO KYA KARNA CHAHIYE:**
- Agar BECHNE wale hain: Global tezi ek acha mauka hai — Monday ko bech do ₹1,960-₹2,000 ke daam mein.
- Agar KHAREEDNE wale hain: CBOT ki tezi se India mein bhi daam support mein hai — abhi zyada sasta nahi milega. May 12-15 tak ruko.

news_items.title: Bihar sarkar ka Krishi Input Anudaan — hailstorm aur baarish se prabhavit makka kisanon ko seedha bank mein paise — apply karne ki akhiri tarikh 5 May 2026
news_items.category: Sarkar Ki Sahayata — Kisan Relief Scheme
news_items.explanation:
**KYA HUA:** Bihar sarkar ne Krishi Input Anudaan Yojana 2026 (matlab khet ka kharcha wapas dene ki sarkar ki ek scheme) shuru ki hai — jo makka kisanon ko olo girne (hailstorm) aur baemausam baarish se hua nuksan wapas degi. Yeh paise seedha bank account mein aayenge. Raiyet (zameen ke maalik) aur gair-raiyet (kiraye ki zameen par kheti karne wale) — dono apply kar sakte hain. **AKHIRI TARIKH: 5 May 2026 — aaj se sirf 2 din baaki!**

**MATLAB KYA HAI:** Krishi Input Anudaan matlab sarkar ek seedha paise ka sahara deti hai jinhe fasal khraab ho gayi — jaise insurance milta hai. DBT Agriculture Bihar website par ya aapke nearest Common Service Centre (CSC — gaon mein ek sarkari daftar) par jaake apply kar sakte hain. Agar aapki makka ki fasal is saal ke hailstorm (March-April) mein kharab hui thi, toh yeh paise milna chahiye.

**AAPKI FASAL PAR ASAR:** Yeh scheme seedha daam nahi badhati — par kisan bhai ko paise milenge, woh zyada care se bech sakenge. Jab kisan ko jaldi paise ki zaroorat nahi, toh woh sahi daam ka intezaar kar sakta hai. Yeh ek chhoti si bullish baat hai.

**AAPKO KYA KARNA CHAHIYE:**
- Agar aapki fasal is saal olo ya baarish se kharab hui: ABHI APPLY KAR DO — kal 5 May deadline hai. DBT Agriculture Bihar website ya CSC centre par jaao.
- Kisi bhi kisan bhai ko batao jo apply nahi kiya hai — waqt nikal raha hai!

news_items.title: IMD alert 3 May — Bihar ke paas bhaari baarish aur olo girne ki warning — West Bengal aur Sikkim (Purnea se lagpas) mein heavy rain — arrivals aaj ruki
news_items.category: IMD Mausam — Bihar Ke Paas Baarish Alert
news_items.explanation:
**KYA HUA:** IMD (India Meteorological Department — India ka mausam vibhag) ne aaj 3 May ke liye Sub-Himalayan West Bengal aur Sikkim, Northeast India mein 'heavy to very heavy rainfall' (badi bhaari baarish) ki warning di hai. Purnea zilaah West Bengal ki seema (border) se bilkul lagpas hai — toh is baarish ka asar North Bihar ke maize belt mein bhi ho sakta hai. April 26 ko Bihar ke 13 ziloon mein Orange Alert (bhaari baarish + olo) tha jisme 5 log maar gaye the.

**MATLAB KYA HAI:** Mausam kharab hone se khet mein khari makka bheegi reh jaati hai, tractors khet mein nahi ja sakte, aur mandi mein maal lane mein dikkat hoti hai. Aaj Ravivaar hai toh waise bhi mandi band hai. Par kal Monday ko bhi agar baarish rahi toh Purnea area mandi mein arrivals thodi kam hongi — iska matlab daam thoda sustain hoga.

**AAPKI FASAL PAR ASAR:** Baarish se arrivals slow hongi — yeh short-term mein daam ke liye thoda accha hai. Bilkul waise jaise aam ke mela mein baarish se ek din ke liye kam aam aata hai — toh thoda mehnga milta hai. Par yeh zyada dino tak nahi chalega — Monday-Tuesday se phir normal ho jaayega.

**AAPKO KYA KARNA CHAHIYE:**
- Agar BECHNE wale hain: Agar aapka maal abhi tak geela hai — pehle sukhao, phir becho. Geele maal ka daam kaafi kam milta hai (moisture penalty).
- Agar KHAREEDNE wale hain: Baarish ke baad zyada sukha maal aayega — Monday-Tuesday accha maal milega mandi mein.

news_items.title: WASDE April 9 mein global coarse grain paidawar 5.1 MMT aur badhi — May 9 ko agli report — duniya mein zyada anaj hai — India ke liye bearish signal
news_items.category: International — WASDE USDA Global Supply Bearish
news_items.explanation:
**KYA HUA:** WASDE (World Agricultural Supply and Demand Estimates — America ki sarkar ka ek bada monthly report jo duniya mein kul kitni fasal pai aur kitni bikhegi yeh batata hai — bilkul waise jaise gaon ke mukhia ka hisaab kitaab) April 9, 2026 ko aaya tha. Usme bataya gaya ki duniya mein coarse grains (motey anaaj — jisme makka sabse bada hissa hai) ki paidawar pichle mahine ke anumaan se 5.1 MMT (Million Metric Tonne — 51 lakh tonne — bahut bada dher) aur zyada hogi. Total global coarse grain 1.598 billion tonnes (159 crore tonne!) ho gayi.

**MATLAB KYA HAI:** Duniya mein jab zyada makka pada hota hai, toh India ke khareedaar sochte hain 'zaroorat padi toh bahar se le sakte hain' — toh India ke ghare mandi mein daam par downward pressure padta hai. Brazil mein bhi is saal record paidawar hai (138.9 MMT CONAB ke hisaab se vs USDA ka 132 MMT — 6.9 MMT ka farq). Agla WASDE May 9 (agli Shukravar) ko aayega — agar usme bhi zyada paidawar dikhaya toh daam aur girenge.

**AAPKI FASAL PAR ASAR:** Duniya mein makka zyada hai — yeh ek bearish factor hai. Lekin Iran ki ladai ki wajah se abhi is factor ka asar kam ho gaya hai (ethanol demand ne daam sustain kiya hai). May 9 WASDE ek important date hai — agar Brazil zyada dikhaya toh ₹20-₹30 per quintal aur gir sakta hai.

**AAPKO KYA KARNA CHAHIYE:**
- Agar BECHNE wale hain: May 9 (WASDE) se pehle — yaani May 8 tak — maal bech dena samajhdaari hai.
- Agar KHAREEDNE wale hain: May 9 ke baad ruko — agar WASDE bearish aaya toh aur sasta milega.

news_items.title: MSP ₹2,400 par sarkar ka daam — mandi mein sirf ₹1,900 — ₹500 ka seedha nuksan — 7 mahine se sarkar khareed nahi rahi — kisan bhai ka haal bura
news_items.category: Sarkar Ka Tay Kiya Daam vs Mandi Ka Asli Daam
news_items.explanation:
**KYA HUA:** Purnea mandi mein aaj makka ₹1,900 per quintal (100 kilo) chal rahi hai. Sarkar ne MSP (Minimum Support Price — matlab sarkar ka tay kiya hua neeche ka daam — is se kam mein nahi bikni chahiye) ₹2,400 per quintal rakha hai is saal ke liye. Toh ₹500 per quintal ka seedha nuksan! October 2025 se lekar May 2026 tak — poore 7 mahine se — mandi lagatar MSP ke NEECHE chal rahi hai.

**MATLAB KYA HAI:** MSP matlab woh daam jo sarkar tay karti hai ki 'itna toh milna chahiye kisan ko.' Lekin mandi mein ₹1,900 chal raha hai — ₹500 NEECHE MSP se! Aise samjho: sarkar ne bola ki 100 kilo makka ₹2,400 mein bikni chahiye — par mandi mein sirf ₹1,900 mil raha hai. Matlab ₹500 ka seedha ghata hai kisan ko. Aur sarkar khud bhi procurement (sarkari kharidi) nahi kar rahi — koi sarkari agency nahi khareed rahi. Yeh structural oversupply ka saaf sanket hai — bahut zyada maal, khareedaar nahi.

**AAPKI FASAL PAR ASAR:** Jab tak sarkar procurement shuru na kare ya Iran ki ladai se demand itni badhe ki MSP tak pahunche, tab tak mandi ₹1,900-₹2,000 mein hi rahegi. Daam ₹2,400 tak pahunchna agle kai hafte mein nahi hoga.

**AAPKO KYA KARNA CHAHIYE:**
- Agar BECHNE wale hain: Sarkar ka daam aane ka intezaar mat karo. Jo hai woh becho — aaj Monday tak. Rakhna ghata hai.
- Agar KHAREEDNE wale hain: ₹1,900 ka daam baaki coarse grains ke mukable abhi bhi fair price hai. Sahi waqt par khareedate raho.

Kisan bhai ke liye: jab America mein makka itna badh raha hai, India mein bhi demand ka support milta hai. NCDEX ka ₹2,000 pahunchna bhi isi global tezi ki wajah se tha. Yeh ek bullish khabar hai.

video_news.title: Bihar Mein Rabi Makka Ka Ruqba 41.27% Badha — Is Saal Ki Badi Paidawar Mandi Mein Daam Ko Dabayegi — Kisan Bhai Jaldi Becho

video_news.description: Ek bade agricultural expert (Suresh Singh Chauhan) ne LinkedIn par report di hai ki Bihar mein rabi makka ka ruqba (area — kitne khet mein boi gayi) UPAG ke data ke hisaab se pichle saal se 41.27% ZYADA hai — 7.77 lakh hectare! Agar yield (per khet paidawar) normal rahi toh Bihar se 4.42 MMT (44 lakh tonne) makka aayegi. Maharashtra mein bhi 52.25% ruqba badha. Kisan bhai ke liye: itna zyada maal mandi mein aayega ki daam par dabaav zaroor padega. May 15 tak sabse zyada arrivals hongi. Jaldi becho — ruko mat.

video_news.description: Moneycontrol ne bataya hai ki IMD (India Meteorological Department — India ka mausam vibhag) ne 3 May ke liye Sub-Himalayan West Bengal, Sikkim, aur Northeast India mein bhaari baarish aur olo girne ki warning di hai. Andhra Pradesh mein heatwave (loo lagna) bhi chal rahi hai. Purnea West Bengal ki seema ke bilkul paas hai — toh is baarish ka asar North Bihar ke makka belt mein bhi ho sakta hai. Kisan bhai ke liye: baarish se geela maal mandi nahi aa sakta — short-term mein daam ko thoda support milega. Par zyada dino tak nahi chalega — Tuesday-Wednesday se arrivals wapas normal hongi.

video_news.title: E20 Niyam 32 Din Baad — Petrol Mein Makka Ki Sharab Milana Lazmi — Distillery Wale Steady Khareed Rahe Hain — AIDA E27 Maang Rahi Hai
video_news.published_display: 1 April 2026 se lagu — E20 niyam ka taza haal
video_news.description: E20 mandate (sarkar ka niyam jisme petrol mein 20% ethanol — makka ya ganna se bani sharab — milana lazmi hai) 1 April 2026 se poore desh mein lagu ho gaya. Aaj 32 din ho gaye hain. Pehle distillery waale (makka se ethanol banane wali factories) jaldi jaldi khareed rahe the — woh phase khatam. Ab steady, planned kharidi chal rahi hai — koi aagadhbhaagi nahi. India ke ethanol mein 45.68% hissa makka ka hai — matlab makka ka ek permanent khareedaar ban gaya hai. AIDA (distillery waalon ki sanstha) E27 (27% ethanol) aur E30 ki maang kar rahi hai sarkar se. Kisan bhai ke liye: yeh long-term ke liye bahut acchi khabar hai — makka ki permanent demand rahegi.

video_news.title: WASDE April 9 — Duniya Mein Coarse Grain 5.1 MMT Aur Badhi — Brazil Mein Record Paidawar — May 9 Ko Agle Mahine Ki Report
video_news.published_display: April 9, 2026 — WASDE report ka global coarse grain data
video_news.description: America ki sarkar (USDA — US Department of Agriculture, matlab America ka Krishi Mantralaya) ki April 9 WASDE (World Agricultural Supply and Demand Estimates — duniya bhar ki fasal ki supply aur demand ki monthly report) ne bataya ki global coarse grain (motey anaaj — jisme makka ka sabse bada hissa hai) paidawar pichle anumaan se 5.1 MMT (51 lakh tonne) aur zyada hogi — kul 1.598 billion tonnes. Brazil mein bhi CONAB (Brazil ki apni fasal ki sanstha) ne 138.9 MMT makka bataya — USDA ke 132 MMT se 6.9 MMT zyada. Duniya mein itna makka pada hai. Agli WASDE May 9 (agle Shukravar) ko aayegi. Kisan bhai ke liye: duniya mein zyada maal hai — toh daam pe downward pressure rehta hai — lekin Iran ki ladai ne is asar ko abhi ke liye kuch kam kar diya hai.

video_news.title: India Mein DDGS Deal — 5 Lakh Tonne Sasta Murgi Chaara — FSSAI Ka GM Niyam Roka Hua — Abhi Bhi Pending — Kisan Ke Liye Kya Matlab
video_news.published_display: Feb 8, 2026 — India-US DDGS deal ka taza haal
video_news.description: America aur India ke beech DDGS (Distillers Dried Grains with Solubles — makka se alcohol banaane ke baad bacha hua chaara — jo murgiyon aur janwaron ko khilaate hain) ka ek deal hua — 5 lakh tonne bina tax ke aa sakta hai. Lekin FSSAI (khaane ki safety sanstha) ka niyam hai ki 'GM-free certificate' chahiye — aur America ka DDGS GM makka (lab mein badla gaya beej) se banta hai toh certificate nahi milti. Toh abhi tak bahut kam DDGS aaya. GM status abhi PENDING hai. Kisan bhai ke liye: agar FSSAI clearance de di toh murgi-wale makka ki jagah yeh sasta chaara khareedenge — makka ki demand ₹3-₹5 per quintal girega. Abhi koi asar nahi — par nazar rakhna.

Abhi dono taqatein barabar hain — isliye 'thoda bullish' mood hai, 'bahut bullish' nahi.
market_sentiment.summary: Aaj 3 May 2026 (Ravivaar) — mandi band hai. Par jab kal Monday ko khulegi toh kisan bhai ko ek milja-jula market milega. Doosri taraf: Bihar mein rabi makka ka ruqba pichle saal se 41.27% ZYADA hai — itna zyada maal mandi mein aa raha hai ki daam pe bada dabaav hai. Kul milaker: NCDEX aur global signals bullish hain, par Bihar ki badi paidawar bearish hai. Kisan bhai ke liye: Monday ko becho — ₹1,960-₹2,000 milne ki poori sambhavna hai Gulabbagh mandi mein. May 15 ke baad mat baitho — tab arrivals peak par hongi aur daam ₹1,840 tak gir sakta hai.

predictions_10_day.trend_text: Din 1 (3 May, Ravivaar — Sunday) mein daam ₹1,900 par wahi rahega kyunki aaj poori Bihar mein mandi BAND hai — Ravivaar ko koi kharida-bechi nahi hoti. Daam wahi rahega jo kal tha. Kisan bhai: aaj ghar par aram karo, kal ki tayari karo.

Din 3 (5 May, Mangalwaar) mein daam ₹10 aur gira ₹1,882 par aayega kyunki rabi arrivals tezi se badh rahi hain — pichle saal ke mukable 41.27% zyada maal mandi mein aa raha hai. Jaise aam ke mela mein sab ek saath aam laayein toh daam toot jaata hai — wahi haal hai. Aaj Krishi Input Anudaan ki bhi akhiri tarikh hai — kuch kisan jaldi bechenge apply karne ke baad. NCDEX bhi thoda adjust ho raha hai ₹1,950-₹1,960 ke aas paas. Kisan bhai: ab rakhna ghata ki sauda hai — jo maal pada hai woh ZAROOR becho.

Din 6 (8 May, Shukravar) mein daam ₹8 aur gira ₹1,856 par aayega. Kal May 9 ko WASDE (America ki badi global fasal report) aayegi — toh aaj market thoda cautious ho gayi hai. Traders 'wait and see' kar rahe hain. Kisan bhai: WASDE se pehle becho — agar kal WASDE mein Brazil zyada dikhaya toh aur tez giraawat ho sakti hai.

Din 7 (9 May, Shanivaar — Saturday) mein daam ₹4 gira ₹1,852 par aayega. Aaj WASDE (America ki USDA agency ki monthly global farming report — jisme duniya mein kitna makka hai yeh bataya jaata hai) bhi aayegi — agar Brazil zyada dikhaya toh zyada asar hoga. Saturday ko mandi half-day hoti hai — trading ka time kam hai. Iran ki ladai ka koi bada update bhi aa sakta hai. Kisan bhai: NCDEX ke ₹1,845-₹1,850 support level par pahunch rahe hain.

Din 8 (10 May, Ravivaar — Sunday) mein daam ₹1,852 par wahi rahega — kyunki Ravivaar ko mandi band rehti hai. Koi badlav nahi. Kisan bhai: aaj ghar par baithke WASDE ki khabar ka asar sochna — kal Monday ko bhi becho.

Din 9 (11 May, Somwaar) mein daam ₹5 aur gira ₹1,847 par aayega. WASDE ke baad market ka reaction aa raha hai. Arrivals dheere dheere taper (kam) hone ke qareeb hain — May 15 ke baad peak season khatam hogi. NCDEX ₹1,840-₹1,845 target zone mein hai. Iran ki ladai ka koi surprise bhi aa sakta hai. Kisan bhai: ab arrivals tapering ke karib hain — agla month daam thoda stabilize ho sakta hai.

Din 10 (12 May, Mangalwaar) mein daam ₹5 aur gira ₹1,842 par aayega. Yeh woh level hai jahaan NCDEX aur market analysts ka support dikhata hai. ₹1,842 se neeche jaana mushkil hoga — kyunki ethanol demand ka support hai. Kisan bhai jo khareedna chahte hain: ₹1,842-₹1,850 ka level ek accha entry point hai — yahan se daam fir upar jaane ki sambhavna hai.

MSP (sarkar ka tay kiya neeche ka daam) ₹2,400 hai aur mandi mein ₹1,900 chal raha hai — ₹500 ka seedha nuksan! October 2025 se lekar May 2026 tak — puri 7 mahine — mandi lagatar MSP ke NEECHE hai. Sarkar apni koi bhi sarkari kharidi (government procurement) nahi kar rahi. Yeh structural oversupply (bahut zyada maal, khareedaar nahi) ka saaf sanket hai — jaise bazaar mein haar baar ek cheez ki zaroorat se zyada aa jaaye. Sarkar nahi khareed rahi matlab kisan ki koi 'safety net' nahi hai. BEARISH.

April 9, 2026 WASDE (America ki sarkar ki duniya bhar ki fasal ki monthly report) mein bataya gaya ki global coarse grain (motey anaaj — jisme makka sabse bada) paidawar 5.1 MMT aur badhi — kul 1.598 billion tonnes. Brazil mein CONAB (Brazil ki apni farming sanstha) ke hisaab se 138.9 MMT makka — USDA ke 132 MMT se 6.9 MMT zyada! Duniya mein itna makka pada hai ki India ke khareedaar sochte hain 'zaroorat padi toh bahar se le sakte hain.' Isse India mandi mein daam par downward pressure padta hai. Agla WASDE May 9 ko — agar aur zyada dikhaya toh aur zyada girawat. BEARISH.

India-US ke beech 5 lakh tonne DDGS (makka se alcohol banaane ke baad bacha hua chaara — jo murgiyon ko khilaate hain) bina tax ke aane ki deal hui thi. Abhi FSSAI (India ki khaane ki safety sanstha) ka niyam rok raha hai — GM-free certificate chahiye jo America de nahi sakta. Par yeh ek 'latent risk' hai — agar kisi din FSSAI clearance de di, toh murgi-waale makka ki jagah yeh sasta chaara khareedenge — seedha demand loss. Abhi pending hai — par nazar rakhna. MEDIUM BEARISH RISK.
bullish: NCDEX (Delhi ka bada fasal-bazaar) mein makka ka May 2026 futures contract ₹1,992 par hai — pichle 52 hafte ka sabse uchha level ₹2,000 April 29 ko touch kiya tha! Purnea spot daam ₹1,900 se ₹92 UPAR — matlab bade traders aur saari financial computers bol rahi hain ki 'khareedon, daam badhenge.' 1 mahine mein NCDEX ne ₹1,877 se ₹2,000 tak ka safar kiya — ₹123 ki tezi! Yeh ek bahut bada bullish signal hai — jaise gaon mein mukhia ne bola ki kal daam bahut badhega — toh sab khareedne lagte hain. BULLISH.

Iran ki ladai (February 28 se shuru) mein Strait of Hormuz (samandar ka ek zaroori rasta jahan se duniya ka 20% tel guzarta hai) abhi bhi band hai. Brent crude $108 per barrel — pichle saal se 76% zyada! Jab tel itna mehnga hota hai, sarkar ko makka se banane wali sharab (ethanol) bahut zaroori lagti hai — toh distillery waale (ethanol factories) lagatar khareed rahe hain. India mein E20 niyam bhi April 1 se lagu hai — toh permanent structural demand hai. Iran ki ladai band nahi hui — yeh support bana rahega. BAHUT BADA BULLISH FACTOR.

CBOT (America ka sabse bada makka bazaar) mein puri week mein makka 13.25 cents badha — July 2026 contract 480.25 cents par. Corn ke saath wheat aur soybeans bhi bahut badhein — lagta hai duniya mein saari major crops bullish hain. India ka murgi-palan (poultry) industry 8% YoY badhti chal rahi hai — 23.52 MMT makka ki zaroorat har saal. DDGS (substitute chaara) abhi bhi FSSAI ki wajah se nahi aa raha — toh murgi-waale makka hi khareedenge. Yeh ek accha permanent 'demand floor' hai — neeche nahi jaane deta daam ko ₹1,700 se. BULLISH.
neutral: INR (Indian Rupee — hamare rupaye) ki keemat $1 ke mukable ₹94.89 chal rahi hai — ek record low (matlab rupaya bahut kamzor hai). Jab rupaya kamzor hota hai toh bahar se saman mangaana MEHNGA ho jaata hai — toh videsh se makka mangaana bhi mehnga lagega. Isse thoda domestic (India ke andar ki) makka ki demand thodi zyada competitive ho jaati hai — khareedaar sochte hain 'India mein se hi khareedte hain.' Na bahut achha, na bahut bura — NEUTRAL signal.

E20 mandate (petrol mein 20% ethanol milana lazmi) 32 din ho gaye hain. Pre-buy ka phase (jab distillery waale jaldi-jaldi maal khareed rahe the) khatam ho gaya. Ab normalized (aam taur ki) steady kharidi chal rahi hai — na bahut zyada, na bahut kam. Long-term ke liye bahut accha (makka ka permanent khareedaar ban gaya) — lekin short-term mein koi extra boost nahi. AIDA E27 aur E30 ki maang kar rahi hai — agar sarkar sun li toh future mein aur bhi zyada demand hogi. Abhi toh NEUTRAL.
